evidence.excerpt: A cross-border cooperation project between the University of Novi Sad and the University of Miskolc aimed at transferring advanced production management methods to manufacturing SMEs in the Vojvodina and Northern Hungary regions. Hadžić led the work package on pricing and demand management, coordinating survey activities across both countries and delivering a two-day training programme for production managers on workload-based pricing. The project produced a bilingual Serbian–Hungarian practical guide on revenue management for job shops, disseminated to 85 firms through regional chambers of commerce. The project also established a shared dataset of anonymised order records for ongoing research use.
